title: The dashboard shows the dispatch queue and starts and stops the dispatcher
name: queue-screen
description: `sober queue` and `sober dispatch` (packages/cli/src/queue.ts, ADR 0056) are command-line only. Add a screen that lists what is queued, what the dispatcher started, what it is holding and what broke — the same facts `sober queue --watch` prints — and a start/stop control. The dashboard server outlives the tab (ADR 0037); the brief must say whether a dispatcher started from it is the server's child or a detached process, and what happens to it when the server exits. Routes with tests, then the screen. Delete the dispatcher entries from KNOWN_GAPS.
